discord_description: Newly discovered giveaways in one channel of your Discord server. No account or direct messages.
discord_permissions: A server administrator with Manage Server permission can install and configure Claim. Choose an ordinary text channel and grant View Channel, Send Messages, and Embed Links. No Administrator permission or privileged intents are requested.
discord_setup: Choose the channel, Stores, and market. A public settings confirmation appears in that channel. Run setup again to change settings or repair a disabled destination.
discord_status: Privately inspect settings, per-Store readiness, and recent delivery outcomes, including uncertain sends.
discord_stop: Stop alerts and delete this server’s configuration, pending work, and diagnostics. Previously sent messages remain unchanged.
discord_preferences: Setup defaults to all Stores and English/US. Set market to fr-FR for French/France. Set stores to all (including future Stores) or a comma-separated selection: epic-games, prime-gaming, gog, steam. Prime Gaming offers require Prime membership.
discord_baseline: Each Store’s first successful check establishes a silent baseline, not a backlog. Only later new or confirmed returning giveaway periods are announced. Changes apply forward only; a replacement channel receives no catch-up.
discord_reliability: Hourly checks are best-effort, not a delivery guarantee. Short offers and outages can be missed. Pending alerts expire after 24 hours or their deadline. Uncertain sends are never resent: Claim prefers missing an alert over duplicating it. Alerts do not automatically mention anyone.
discord_unavailable: Public installation and support are not enabled on this deployment yet.
discord_data_purpose: Claim uses Discord data only to operate alerts, authorize management commands, provide diagnostics, and prevent replay abuse.
discord_data_stored: We store server/channel identifiers, Store and market preferences, baseline readiness, and delivery outcomes (including sent-message IDs). Independent Store giveaway history is retained separately from Discord server data.
discord_data_transient: Discord sends member metadata and permissions with management commands; these are processed transiently for authorization. We do not store member profiles, raw interactions, interaction tokens, or channel conversations. Unassociated replay hashes expire after ten minutes. Unassociated hashed REST buckets expire when their rate-limit embargo ends; outages can delay cleanup.
discord_retention: Delivery diagnostics are retained for at most 30 days; unrepaired disabled subscriptions and their server data are purged after 30 days. Cleanup requires the Discord runtime to be enabled and the API to be operating; outages or disabled monitoring can delay deletion.
discord_deletion: Use /claim stop to immediately delete the server’s stored configuration, pending alerts, and diagnostics. Sent Discord messages are not edited or deleted.
discord_removal: Bot removal is detected through bounded daily REST checks, even without alerts, and confirmed removal deletes server data. Discord errors, rate limits, or downtime may delay detection.
discord_data_access: Access is restricted to operators and infrastructure needed to provide Claim. Public launch requires verified storage safeguards, including encryption at rest and restricted credentials. Discord receives outgoing alerts; giveaway Stores receive market-specific retrieval requests. Discord data is not sold or used for advertising.
discord_privacy_scope: This policy describes the Discord bot. Website analytics are separate; the site uses the configured cookie-free Plausible tracker. Contact support for bot data questions or verified deletion requests.
discord_requests_description: Use the operator’s private support form for installation problems or data requests. Never send bot tokens, interaction tokens, or other credentials.
discord_verification: For a server-data request, provide the server identifier and explain the request. The operator must verify that you manage the server through an authenticated Discord administrator challenge before disclosing or deleting its data. A server identifier alone is not authorization.
discord_support_stop: If you can still use commands, /claim stop is the fastest authorized deletion path. Removing the bot also triggers deletion once removal is confirmed.
